مُعْتَصِرٌ : One who expresses the juice of grapes, to make wine, for another or others. (Mgh.) [But see 1.] ―
-b2- (tropical:) Voiding ordure: (Mgh, K, * TA:) from عَصْرٌ, or from عَصَرٌ signifying “ a place of refuge or concealment. ” (TA.) ―
-b3- And (tropical:) One who gets, and takes, of, or from, a thing. (S, O.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
